title: ResourceBinding
description: Resolves a ResourceRef to a concrete provisioned resource at runtime. Holds the physical handle ONLY as an opaque, environment-resolved reference (physical_ref) plus a secret_ref/key_ref — never a raw connection string or raw key inline. Bindings live in the resource registry, not in business objects.

physical_ref.description: opaque handle resolved from environment/secret store; not a raw DSN
